mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_project WHERE del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_project WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= date_trunc('month', now())
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_project WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= date_trunc('month', now() - interval '1 month') AND create_time < date_trunc('month', now())
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_project WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '进行中'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(internal_output), 0) AS internalOutput, COALESCE(SUM(external_output), 0) AS externalOutput FROM proj_workload WHERE del_flag = '0'
AND create_time >= date_trunc('month', now())
AND create_time >= date_trunc('quarter', now())
AND create_time >= date_trunc('year', now())

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(internal_output), 0) AS internalOutput, COALESCE(SUM(external_output), 0) AS externalOutput FROM proj_workload WHERE del_flag = '0'
AND create_time >= date_trunc('month', now() - interval '1 month') AND create_time < date_trunc('month', now())
AND create_time >= date_trunc('quarter', now() - interval '3 months') AND create_time < date_trunc('quarter', now())
AND create_time >= date_trunc('year', now() - interval '1 year') AND create_time < date_trunc('year', now())

choose.when: SELECT to_char(d, 'MM-DD') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(w.internal_output), 0) AS internalOutput, COALESCE(SUM(w.external_output), 0) AS externalOutput FROM generate_series( date_trunc('month', now()), date_trunc('month', now() + interval '1 month') - interval '1 day', '1 day'::interval ) d LEFT JOIN proj_workload w ON date_trunc('day', w.create_time) = d AND w.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

SELECT to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(w.internal_output), 0) AS internalOutput, COALESCE(SUM(w.external_output), 0) AS externalOutput FROM generate_series( date_trunc('quarter', now()), date_trunc('quarter', now() + interval '3 months') - interval '1 month', '1 month'::interval ) d LEFT JOIN proj_workload w ON date_trunc('month', w.create_time) = d AND w.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d
choose.otherwise: SELECT to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(w.internal_output), 0) AS internalOutput, COALESCE(SUM(w.external_output), 0) AS externalOutput FROM generate_series( date_trunc('year', now()), date_trunc('year', now() + interval '1 year') - interval '1 month', '1 month'::interval ) d LEFT JOIN proj_workload w ON date_trunc('month', w.create_time) = d AND w.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(contract_amount), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(received_amount), 0) AS receivedAmount FROM proj_contract WHERE del_flag = '0'
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM proj_project WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY status ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT p.id, p.project_name AS projectName, COUNT(t.id) AS totalTasks, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.actual_finish_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS completedTasks, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.id) > 0 THEN ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.actual_finish_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)::numeric / COUNT(t.id) * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS progress FROM proj_project p LEFT JOIN proj_task t ON t.project_id = p.id AND t.del_flag = '0' WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.status = '进行中' GROUP BY p.id, p.project_name ORDER BY progress DESC, p.create_time DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT t.id, t.task_name AS taskName, p.project_name AS projectName, t.required_finish_date AS requiredFinishDate, t.status, (CURRENT_DATE - t.required_finish_date::date) AS overdueDays FROM proj_task t JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = t.project_id WHERE t.del_flag = '0' AND p.del_flag = '0' AND t.actual_finish_date IS NULL AND t.required_finish_date IS NOT NULL AND t.required_finish_date < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY t.required_finish_date ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM proj_material WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY status

SELECT t.id, t.task_name AS taskName, p.project_name AS projectName, t.required_finish_date AS requiredFinishDate, t.status, t.assign_date AS assignDate, CASE WHEN t.required_finish_date IS NOT NULL AND t.required_finish_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN (CURRENT_DATE - t.required_finish_date::date) ELSE 0 END AS overdueDays FROM proj_task t JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = t.project_id WHERE t.del_flag = '0' AND p.del_flag = '0' AND t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.actual_finish_date IS NULL ORDER BY t.required_finish_date ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
